title.zh-TW: grok --resume 依更新時間排序工作階段，找不到本機紀錄時即刻回報
title.en: grok --resume sorts sessions by update time and immediately reports when local records are missing

body.zh-TW:
當你累積了大量對話想重新接續先前的工作進度，只憑模糊印象輸入名稱往往難以精準定位。⟦如同在圖書館櫃檯查詢借閱紀錄，以前一旦館內找不到藏書，館方電腦便主動發起外館調閱並要求重新刷卡驗證；現在螢幕直接按最後更新時間由近到遠條列項目，若沒有相符紀錄還會提示相近名稱，找不到時立即告知結果。⟧

執行 `grok --resume <title>` 恢復對話時，列出的相符工作階段會依據最後更新時間由新到舊排序，並清楚附上各自的最近更新時間。要是輸入的名稱完全沒有符合的紀錄，命令列會主動推薦相似的標題供你挑選。

當指定的標題在本地電腦中完全不存在時，命令列現在會立即回報未找到，而不是嘗試發起遠端還原程序並要求你登入帳號。
body.en:
When you have accumulated many conversations and want to resume earlier progress, typing a name from vague memory often makes precise targeting difficult. ⟦Think of checking borrowing records at a library counter. Previously, whenever a book was missing from the collection, the computer initiated an interlibrary loan and required card reverification; now, the screen lists items from newest to oldest by last update time, suggests similar names if no record matches, and reports the result immediately when nothing is found.⟧

When running `grok --resume <title>` to resume a conversation, matching sessions are listed in order from newest to oldest based on their last update time, clearly displaying their respective recent update times. If the entered name has no matching records at all, the command line recommends similar titles for you to choose from.

When the specified title does not exist at all on the local machine, the command line now immediately reports that it was not found, instead of attempting to initiate a remote restore process and asking you to log in.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器按 Shift+Y 複製游標所在的程式碼區塊
title.en: Full-screen Markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor with Shift+Y

body.zh-TW:
閱讀長篇技術文件或檢視終端機輸出時，切換到全螢幕檢視器能讓排版更為乾淨，但想取用其中的範例段落往往需要額外步驟。⟦彷彿拿著手持掃描器在貨架間盤點，以前想記錄規格得拿出紙筆沿著邊界逐字謄寫，現在光點只要對準商品標籤扣下按鍵，整組資料便立刻收進隨身清單。⟧

在全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器中，現在只要將游標移動到目標程式碼上方，按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Y`，就會複製游標所在的整個程式碼區塊。如此一來，閱讀長篇文件時便能直接擷取所需的指令或程式碼片段，不必再特地動用滑鼠手動框選。
body.en:
When reading long technical documents or inspecting terminal output, switching to a full-screen viewer keeps the layout cleaner, but grabbing example passages often takes extra steps. ⟦Picture taking inventory among store shelves with a handheld scanner. Previously, recording specifications meant pulling out pen and paper to transcribe character by character along the margins; now, aiming the light beam at a product label and pressing a button instantly pulls the whole dataset into a portable list.⟧

In the full-screen Markdown viewer, moving the cursor over target code and pressing `Shift+Y` now copies the entire code block beneath the cursor. Reading long documents this way lets you capture needed commands or snippets directly without reaching for a mouse to highlight them manually.

items.original: `Shift+Y` in the fullscreen markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor

title.zh-TW: 從儀表板開啟工作階段時，按 Esc 聚焦回捲歷程而非退回儀表板
title.en: Pressing Esc focuses scrollback instead of returning to dashboard when opening a session

body.zh-TW:
從儀表板開啟特定工作階段準備輸入指令時，要是想先檢閱先前的上下文，直覺按鍵往往可能帶來非預期的畫面切換。⟦跟參觀特展展示台一樣，以前在互動導覽的第一道題目按下返回鍵，畫面會冷不防退回接待大廳；現在只會把檢視游標移到上方的過往解說板，與獨立參觀時的行為完全相同。⟧

以前從儀表板開啟工作階段後，若在第一個提問處按下 `Esc`，畫面會直接關閉並退回儀表板。現在按下 `Esc` 時，焦點會切換到上方儲存的回捲歷程（scrollback，可往上捲動查看歷史輸出的區域）。這樣的一致行為與直接在終端機啟動的獨立工作階段相同，避免你為了查看先前的對話而中斷手頭上的流程。
body.en:
When opening a session from the dashboard to enter commands, intuitive keystrokes can often trigger unexpected view switches if you want to inspect earlier context first. ⟦Like visiting a special exhibition booth, pressing back at the first question of an interactive guide used to kick you back to the reception hall without warning; now, it only shifts the viewing cursor up to the previous display board, behaving exactly like a self-guided tour.⟧

Previously, after opening a session from the dashboard, pressing `Esc` at the first prompt would close the view and return directly to the dashboard. Now, pressing `Esc` shifts focus to the saved scrollback (the buffer area for scrolling up to inspect past output). This consistent behavior matches standalone sessions started directly in the terminal, preventing interruptions to your workflow when you only want to review prior dialogue.

items.original: `Esc` on the first question in a session opened from the dashboard moves focus to the scrollback, as it does in a standalone session, instead of returning to the dashboard

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆內容保留原始定位字元，程式碼區塊標註語言與檔名
title.en: Copying responses preserves original tab characters, while code blocks label language and file names

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話結束後整理 Grok 生成的內容，想把程式碼或整段說明貼到自己的編輯器時，複製功能帶來了更乾淨的操作體驗。⟦如同在電子筆記中剪貼參考資料，標籤清楚標記出每段摘錄的來源格式，無論切換成精簡視窗還是全螢幕檢視，底部的操作列都能整齊排版，貼到其他文件時也保留了原本的段落縮排。⟧已完成的回覆中，每個程式碼區塊下方現在都會顯示 `[Copy]` 複製按鈕，並標明該段程式碼所屬的語言或檔案名稱。如果你在精簡模式與全螢幕模式之間切換，程式碼區塊、表格與圖表底部的複製列現在都能正確顯示，不會再出現版面錯位。複製整個程式碼區塊或整篇回覆時，內容會維持原有的定位字元（tab），不再被自動替換成空格。
body.en: When organizing Grok-generated content after a conversation to paste code or full explanations into your editor, the copy features deliver a cleaner workflow. ⟦Think of clipping reference notes into a digital notebook: tags clearly mark the source format of each excerpt, the bottom action bar stays neatly arranged whether switching between compact and full-screen views, and original paragraph indentations remain intact when pasted into other documents.⟧ In completed responses, every code block now displays a `[Copy]` button below it, labeling the language or file name for that code. If you switch between compact mode and full-screen mode, the copy bar at the bottom of code blocks, tables, and charts renders correctly without layout misalignment. When copying an entire code block or a full response, content preserves its original tab characters instead of being automatically replaced with spaces.

items.original:
`[Copy]` buttons appear under code blocks in finished replies, labeled with the language or file name of the code
Copy rows under code blocks, tables, and diagrams display correctly after switching between minimal and fullscreen modes
Copying a code block or a whole reply keeps its original tabs instead of turning them into spaces

title.zh-TW: PowerShell 掛鉤支援讀取輸入變數，回傳中斷指令確實終止對話
title.en: PowerShell hooks support reading input variables, reliably ending conversations on abort commands

body.zh-TW: 當你撰寫自動化指令來介入 AI 對話流程時，自訂掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在具備更穩定的執行彈性。⟦好比在自動化生產線設置檢驗站，感測器遇到非標準格式的進料時先亮黃燈警示並繼續運作，而當品檢員送出停機訊號時，輸送帶也能確實立刻停止。⟧過去在進階 PowerShell 行內掛鉤中，如果程式碼讀取了 `$input` 變數，整個掛鉤會直接失敗。現在它會印出警告訊息並維持執行。當掛鉤回傳 `continue: false` 時，AI 現在會依指示確實停止該輪對話，不再像以前那樣直接忽略中斷訊號。這確保了前置檢查未通過時，後續的推理動作不會擅自繼續進行。
body.en: When writing automated commands to intervene in AI conversation flows, custom hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) now offer more reliable execution flexibility. ⟦Picture an inspection station on an automated assembly line: sensors flash a yellow warning light and keep running when encountering non-standard feeds, while the conveyor belt reliably stops immediately when quality inspectors send an abort signal.⟧ Previously in advanced PowerShell inline hooks, if code read the `$input` variable, the entire hook failed outright. It now prints a warning message and continues executing. When a hook returns `continue: false`, the AI reliably stops that turn of conversation as instructed, rather than ignoring the abort signal as before. This ensures that subsequent reasoning steps will not proceed unauthorized if pre-checks fail.

items.original:
Advanced PowerShell inline hooks that read `$input` run with a warning instead of failing
Hooks that return `continue: false` stop the turn instead of being ignored

title.zh-TW: 儀表板空指令改顯示用法說明，預覽貼上支援 Esc 與換列取消
title.en: Dashboard empty commands now display usage instructions, while preview paste supports cancellation via Esc or switching rows

body.zh-TW: 在儀表板檢視專案或輸入指令時，介面現在能妥善防範誤觸所帶來的非預期動作。⟦彷彿操作精密儀器的控制面板，空按循環按鈕只會跳出使用教學而不會直接啟動新排程，若在準備貼上資料的中途切換選單或按下取消鍵，儀表板也會主動提示已中止任務，避免指令在背景默默送出。⟧在儀表板中，如果你輸入了 `/loop` 循環指令卻沒有附帶提示詞，現在只會顯示該指令的使用方法，不會再開啟一個新的工作階段（session）。當你在快速預覽視窗中等待貼上剪貼簿內容時，只要把焦點移動到其他資料列或按下 Esc 鍵，該筆待送出的回覆就會立刻取消，並跳出浮動通知告知狀態，不再滯留並於稍後意外送出。
body.en: When viewing projects or entering commands in the dashboard, the interface now properly guards against unintended actions caused by accidental triggers. ⟦A control panel on precision equipment provides a fitting parallel: pressing a loop button with no arguments only displays a tutorial rather than launching a fresh schedule, and switching menus or hitting cancel midway through pasting data prompts an alert that the task was aborted before commands can silently send in the background.⟧ In the dashboard, entering the `/loop` command without an accompanying prompt now only displays usage instructions for that command, instead of opening a new session. When waiting to paste clipboard content in the quick preview window, simply moving focus to another row or pressing the Esc key immediately cancels that pending response and triggers a toast notification with the status, rather than lingering to send unexpectedly later.

items.original:
Dashboard `/loop` without a prompt shows its usage instead of starting a new session
Dashboard peek replies waiting on a clipboard paste are canceled with a toast when you move the peek to another row or press Esc, instead of being sent later

title.zh-TW: `grok --resume` 支援任意分隔符，找舊工作階段不再需要精確符號
title.en: `grok --resume` supports arbitrary delimiters, eliminating the need for exact symbols when finding past sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續之前的對話進度，在終端機喚回舊的工作階段（session）時，標題搜尋不再要求字元完全一致。⟦就像在音樂播放器中搜尋歌名，以前只要把單字之間的空格打成連字號就找不到曲目，現在搜尋功能會自動忽略符號差異，隨手輸入片段詞彙就能立即找出收藏的歌曲。⟧現在執行 `grok --resume <title>` 時，指令會自動忽略標題單字之間的連接符號。即使原本的紀錄名稱是「Fix login bug」，你只要輸入 `grok --resume fix-login-bug`，甚至用底線分隔單字，都能順利找到並重啟該次工作階段。這省去了每次接續專案前，都得先翻找歷史紀錄確認精確標題大小寫與空格格式的麻煩。
body.en: When resuming past conversation progress and recalling old sessions in the terminal, title searches no longer demand character-for-character precision. ⟦Like searching for song titles in a music player, where typing a hyphen instead of a space between words once yielded no tracks, the search feature now ignores punctuation differences so entering word fragments immediately locates saved songs.⟧ Now when running `grok --resume <title>`, the command automatically ignores joining symbols between title words. Even if the original recorded name is "Fix login bug", typing `grok --resume fix-login-bug` or separating words with underscores will successfully locate and restart that session. This saves the hassle of digging through history before resuming a project just to confirm exact title casing and spacing.

items.original: `grok --resume <title>` matches a title whatever separates its words, so `fix-login-bug` finds "Fix login bug"

title.zh-TW: `grok worktree rm` 修正錯誤提示，無法強制移除時不再建議 `-f`
title.en: `grok worktree rm` fixes error hints, no longer suggesting `-f` when force removal is impossible

body.zh-TW: 當你使用指令清理專案工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，終端機不再給出無效的排錯建議。⟦正如前往快遞櫃檯寄送物品，如果物件本身因體積超標而無法收件，人員便不會再建議你改買特快專遞方案，避免你多跑一趟流程卻依然被退件。⟧過去執行 `grok worktree rm` 移除工作樹時，如果遇到了受保護或無法直接刪除的狀態，錯誤訊息往往會建議加上 `-f` 參數強制移除；但實際上即便你真的補上 `-f`，指令仍然會拒絕刪除該工作樹。現在這項不實用的提示已經移除，只有在 `-f` 確實能發揮強制刪除效果時，終端機才會提示該選項。
body.en: When using commands to clean up project worktrees (a Git feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project), the terminal no longer offers ineffective troubleshooting advice. ⟦Just as visiting a courier counter to ship a package means staff will not suggest switching to express delivery if an oversized parcel cannot be accepted at all, you are spared an extra trip that still ends in rejection.⟧ Previously, when running `grok worktree rm` to remove a worktree that was protected or could not be directly deleted, error messages often recommended adding the `-f` flag for force removal. In reality, even if you supplied `-f`, the command still refused to delete the worktree. This unhelpful hint has now been removed, and the terminal suggests the option only when `-f` can genuinely carry out a forced deletion.

items.original: `grok worktree rm` no longer suggests `-f` for a worktree that `-f` would also refuse to remove

body.en: When you want to pick up where you left off, the terminal can now locate historical records faster and handle input more smoothly. ⟦Picture requesting guest logs at a hotel front desk: the clerk filters specific records simply by name or room number; even if a few pages of an old ledger are torn, the desk keeps a backup and recovers all readable data without holding up new guest registrations.⟧ Now, typing `/resume` accepts an optional session ID or title to directly open a menu filtered to matching entries. body.zh-TW: 當你想在不干擾主要程式碼的情況下嘗試實驗性改動，Git 工作樹（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）能幫你建立獨立分支。⟦如同從原生盆栽剪下枝條移到獨立花盆培育，園丁在分盆修剪或施肥時，修剪動作都不會碰傷原本母株的根葉。⟧現在當你執行 `grok -w -r` 或在對話中輸入 `/fork` 分支出工作樹，終端機不僅會顯示工作樹路徑，所有操作也會切實切換至該路徑下執行。以往在分支出工作樹後執行 Shell 指令，指令往往會誤改到原本的檢出目錄；現在路徑明確切換後，終端機指令不再更動原始目錄。當你為了重構特定模組而分支出工作樹時，可以在獨立路徑下放手執行編譯與修改指令，確保原始專案內容維持原狀。
body.en: When you want to try experimental changes without disrupting primary code, Git worktrees (a feature allowing parallel copies of the same project) help you set up isolated branches. ⟦Think of clipping cuttings from a potted plant to nurture in a separate pot: pruning or fertilizing in the new container never harms the roots or leaves of the parent plant.⟧ Now when you run `grok -w -r` or enter `/fork` in conversation to fork a worktree, the terminal not only displays the worktree path, but also switches all operations directly into that path. In the past, running Shell commands after forking a worktree often accidentally modified the original checkout directory; with explicit path switching now in place, terminal commands no longer touch the original directory. title.zh-TW: 輸入焦點與反饋草稿加強防護，快捷送出避開背景卡片
title.en: Input focus and feedback drafts gain protections, with instant submissions bypassing background cards

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入回覆或反饋時，最怕突如其來的提示視窗搶走游標焦點。⟦跟在郵局櫃檯填單一樣，以前只要後方號碼牌一響或專員遞件，手上的表格就會被收走；現在檯面保留你的書寫空間，讓你從容寫完手頭內容。⟧在輸入 `/feedback` 時，即使中途收到權限請求、提問或外部工具提示，反饋視窗依然會維持開啟。讀取反饋草稿時，即便有單一草稿損毀，其餘有效草稿仍會正常載入。輸入 `@` 提及檔案時，會重複使用暫存的檔案清單，直到資料夾結構改變才重新掃描，讓候選建議更快出現。嘗試編輯排隊中的指令（例如 `/compact`）時會跳出提示並拒絕操作，完整保留你剛鍵入的新文字。按 `Ctrl+Enter` 立即送出時，不再會誤回答停止子代理人面板或外部工具提示卡片。
body.en: When typing responses or feedback in the terminal, sudden popups stealing cursor focus are especially disruptive. ⟦Like filling out forms at a post office counter where a chiming ticket or an arriving clerk previously whisked away your paperwork, the desk now reserves your writing space so you can finish the task at hand unhurriedly.⟧ When entering `/feedback`, the feedback window stays open even if permission prompts, questions, or external tool notices arrive in the background. When loading feedback drafts, remaining valid drafts still load normally even if a single draft is corrupted. Typing `@` to mention files reuses a cached file list until directory structures change before rescanning, making suggestions appear faster. Attempting to edit a queued command (such as `/compact`) displays a prompt and rejects the action, fully preserving your newly typed text. Pressing `Ctrl+Enter` to submit immediately no longer accidentally answers stop subagent panels or external tool prompt cards.

items.original:
`/feedback` stays open while you type when a permission request, question, or MCP prompt arrives
`/feedback` Drafts load the valid drafts when one saved draft is invalid
Editing a queued command such as `/compact` is refused with a message, so your new text is kept
Send now (`Ctrl+Enter`) no longer answers the stop-subagents panel or an MCP prompt card
@-mentions reuse the file list until the folder tree changes, so suggestions appear faster

title.zh-TW: 外部工具支援平行輸入提示，啟動旗標落實互動介面權限
title.en: External tools support parallel input prompts, with launch flags enforcing interactive terminal permissions

body.zh-TW: 透過外接工具擴充 AI 的操作能力時，精準的權限範圍與清晰的互動提示格外關鍵。啟動時設定的 `--tools` 與 `--disallowed-tools` 工具名單，現在於互動式終端介面中也會生效。當模型透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）平行呼叫多個需要輸入的工具時，各呼叫會分別顯示自己的提示。設定標準輸入輸出形式的 Stdio MCP 伺服器時，指令與參數開頭的波浪號 `~` 會被展開。`~` 現在會自動展開成你的家目錄，不必手打絕對路徑；平行呼叫各自顯示自己的提示卡片。
body.en: Expanding AI capabilities through external tools demands precise permission boundaries and clear interactive prompts. The `--tools` and `--disallowed-tools` lists configured at launch now take effect inside the interactive terminal interface as well. When models make parallel calls through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) to multiple tools requiring input, each call displays its own prompt. When configuring stdio MCP servers, a leading tilde `~` in commands and arguments is expanded. `~` now automatically expands into your home directory without manually typing absolute paths, and parallel calls display their own distinct prompt cards.

items.original:
`--tools` and `--disallowed-tools` also apply in the interactive TUI
Parallel MCP tool calls that ask for input each show their own prompt
Stdio MCP servers expand a leading `~` in their command and arguments to your home directory

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援 Rex，長對話折疊與排版更俐落
title.en: Terminal Supports Rex, Bringing Cleaner Folding and Layout to Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 平日盯著終端機跟 AI 密切協作時，最怕畫面捲動卡頓或排版突然亂掉。⟦好似在翻閱排版精緻的雜誌，內文欄位整齊對齊邊界，折頁隨手一撥就能俐落展開，不再被折痕切斷字句。⟧現在程式正式支援 Rex 終端機與 OSC 7501 控制序列。終端機裡的工具呼叫群組在有新操作加入時會持續維持展開，長對話中按下 `Ctrl+E` 展開或收折思考過程也更加迅速。如果提示詞或引號裡的超連結因為文字過長而折行，點擊時依然能正確連向完整網址。模型回覆裡的行內標籤不會再破壞版面排版。在工作階段內用來恢復舊工作階段的選單，若設定為不分組，現在會跟歡迎畫面的不分組排版一致。
body.en: Working closely with AI in the terminal, nothing is more frustrating than scrolling stutter or suddenly scrambled formatting. ⟦Picture flipping through a beautifully formatted magazine, where columns align neatly against margins and foldout pages expand smoothly at a touch without creasing through lines of text.⟧ The application now officially supports the Rex terminal and OSC 7501 control sequences. Tool call groups inside the terminal stay expanded when new operations are added, and pressing `Ctrl+E` during long conversations expands or collapses thinking processes much faster. When hyperlinks inside prompts or quotations wrap across lines due to length, clicking them still reliably opens the complete URL. Inline tags within model responses will no longer disrupt layout alignment. In addition, the in-session menu for resuming earlier sessions, when set to ungrouped, now mirrors the ungrouped layout on the welcome screen.

items.original:
Added support for OSC 7501 and the Rex terminal
Expanded tool-call groups stay expanded as new calls join them, and `Ctrl+E` expands or collapses thinking faster in long transcripts
Wrapped URLs in prompts and quotes link to the complete address
Inline tags in agent replies no longer break line layout
The in-session resume picker matches the ungrouped layout on the welcome screen when that layout is configured

title.zh-TW: 子目錄可載入專案掛鉤，狀態列掌握當前回合資訊
title.en: Subdirectories Load Project Hooks, and Status Line Tracks Turn Details

body.zh-TW: 替專案撰寫自動化擴充時，不同目錄的自訂規則現在能精準到位。⟦宛如大樓各樓層的專屬警衛室，進駐該樓層就能啟動當地的巡邏規章，線路故障時當場亮起警示，值班看板也隨時顯示當前任務的接單序號。⟧如果你在儲存庫的子資料夾啟動 grok，該子目錄下的專案掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在會正確載入。連往本機 localhost 的 HTTP 掛鉤也能正常運作，若網址填寫錯誤，載入時就會立刻報錯。終端機底部的指令狀態列（statusLine，終端機最底部的即時資訊列）腳本在回合執行期間，也能順利取得當前回合的提示詞識別碼與開始時間。
body.en: When writing automated extensions for a project, custom rules across different directories now apply with precision. ⟦Think of dedicated guard stations on each building floor, where checking into a floor activates local patrol protocols, wiring faults trigger on-the-spot warnings, and duty boards constantly display order sequence numbers for active tasks.⟧ If you launch grok from a subdirectory of a repository, project hooks under that subdirectory will now load correctly. HTTP hooks connecting to local localhost also operate properly, immediately raising an error during loading if a URL is incorrect. Furthermore, command statusLine scripts at the bottom of the terminal can smoothly retrieve the prompt ID and start time of the current turn while the turn runs.

items.original:
Project hooks in a repository subfolder load when you launch inside that folder
HTTP hooks to localhost work, and bad hook URLs are reported at load time
Command status-line scripts see the current turn prompt ID and start time while the turn is active

title.zh-TW: 模型切換重啟不回彈，思考力度參數嚴格校驗
title.en: Model Switches Persist Across Restarts, with Strict Validation for Effort Flags

body.zh-TW: 當你想換個更合適的模型解題時，設定結果現在會老實保存。⟦如同替專業相機切換拍攝模式，轉盤卡住時不會擅自改寫自訂選單，重新開機依然停在最後選定的檔位，調整進階參數時若鏡頭不支援也會亮燈提醒。⟧以前使用 `/model` 切換模型若中途失敗，頁尾顯示和儲存的預設模型仍會被改掉，現在切換失敗會維持原狀。切換成功後重新啟動 grok，也不會再倒退回先前的舊模型。如果你使用 `grok -p --effort` 指定思考力度，程式會直接拒絕無效的力度數值；若目前使用的模型忽略這項參數，也會明確發出警告。
body.en: When switching to a more suitable model to solve a problem, your configuration is now reliably preserved. ⟦Much like switching shooting modes on a professional camera, a jammed dial never silently overwrites custom menus, rebooting preserves the last selected gear, and adjusting advanced parameters illuminates a warning light whenever the lens lacks support.⟧ Previously, if switching models via `/model` failed mid-operation, the footer display and saved default model were still overwritten; now, a failed switch leaves the existing state intact. After a successful switch, restarting grok no longer reverts to the previous model. If you use `grok -p --effort` to specify reasoning effort, the program directly rejects invalid effort values, and it explicitly issues a warning if the active model ignores this parameter.

items.original:
`/model` switches that fail no longer change the footer or the saved default model
`grok -p --effort` warns when the model ignores the flag, and refuses invalid effort levels
Restarting after a model switch no longer reverts to the previous model

title.zh-TW: 檔案匯出拒絕覆寫，大圖拒收與搜尋失敗清楚報錯
title.en: File Exports Block Overwrites, with Clear Errors for Large Images and Failed Searches

body.zh-TW: 整理對話紀錄或搜尋專案內容時，操作遇到阻礙不再默默失敗。使用匯出或複製功能時，若目標檔案已經存在，程式會主動拒絕覆寫並顯示清楚的提示訊息，避免原有內容被蓋掉。在終端機貼上超過 50 MB 的超大圖片時，畫面會跳出明確訊息拒絕接收，不再無聲把圖片吃掉。當工具執行 `grep` 搜尋或使用 `list_dir` 列出資料夾時，若遇到搜尋逾時、執行失敗或目錄無法讀取，現在會明確回報錯誤，不再假裝查無資料而回傳空白。以前遇到這些狀況只能自己瞎猜到底有沒有送出或到底查完了沒，現在每一處阻礙都有清楚說明。
body.en: When organizing conversation logs or searching project contents, blocked operations no longer fail silently. When using export or copy features, if the destination file already exists, the program proactively refuses to overwrite it and displays a clear prompt to keep existing content intact. Pasting an oversized image exceeding 50 MB into the terminal triggers an explicit rejection message instead of silently swallowing the file. When tools execute a `grep` search or use `list_dir` to list folders, any search timeout, execution failure, or unreadable directory now explicitly reports an error instead of returning blank output as if nothing was found. Where you previously had to guess whether an operation was dispatched or finished, every obstacle now comes with clear feedback.

items.original:
Export and copy refuse to overwrite an existing file, and show a clear message
Pasted images over 50 MB are rejected with a clear message instead of being dropped silently
`grep` and `list_dir` report a clear error when a search times out or fails, or the folder cannot be read, instead of returning no results

title.zh-TW: 離開乾淨終止背景指令，取消操作清楚標明對象
title.en: Exiting Cleanly Halts Background Commands, and Cancellations Identify Targets

body.zh-TW: 當你決定按下中斷鍵或退出程式，手邊正在跑的任務現在會乾淨收尾。⟦就像舞台監督透過對講機喊卡，所有燈光與後台機關立刻同步停機，場記板明確記下喊停的幕次，不再發生演員散場而機關還在後台空轉的窘境。⟧以前退出 grok 或發送中斷訊號後，部分背景指令仍會私下繼續佔用資源，現在結束時會老實終止所有由它啟動的子行程。在終端機按下取消時，畫面也會清楚印出究竟是哪一道指令被停止。如果你使用 `/workflow stop` 停止工作流程，程式也能精準鎖定當前真正處於執行中的任務，不會誤停其他進程。
body.en: When you hit the interrupt key or exit the program, active tasks now wrap up cleanly. ⟦A stage manager calls cut over the intercom: stage lights and backstage machinery immediately power down in unison, the clapperboard logs the halted scene, and machinery never idles backstage after the cast departs.⟧ Previously, after quitting grok or sending an interrupt signal, certain background commands continued consuming resources behind the scenes; now, exiting faithfully terminates all child processes spawned by the session. When you trigger a cancellation in the terminal, the screen explicitly displays which command was stopped. If you use `/workflow stop` to halt a workflow, the program accurately targets tasks currently running without mistakenly terminating other processes.

items.original:
Shell commands no longer keep running after you quit grok, or after grok receives a signal
Cancelled terminal commands show the command that was stopped
`/workflow stop` picks the correct live run

title.zh-TW: 審核卡片不再突然消失，授權通知明確指名工作階段
title.en: Review Cards Persist Reliably, and Authorization Prompts Specify Sessions

body.zh-TW: 放手讓 AI 在背景處理複雜任務時，需要你點頭授權的關鍵卡片不再跟你玩捉迷藏。⟦好比總經理桌上的急件待辦夾，各部門送上來的簽呈會蓋妥所屬專案的章戳，送達時自動移開桌面上的大型看圖板，即便主幹部的會議散會，底下助理未簽核的請款單依然好好留在桌前。⟧背景子代理（subagent，負責分工處理特定子任務的代理程式）送出的審核卡片，在父回合結束時不會再無故消失。跳出的審核通知現在會明確標示是哪一個工作階段需要你批准。在極簡模式下如果權限提示與隱藏的計畫或取消面板同時出現，畫面會確實呈現該權限提示。每當審核卡片浮現，程式也會自動關閉區塊檢視器，避免卡片內容遭到遮擋。
body.en: When leaving AI to handle complex tasks in the background, the key approval cards requiring your sign-off will no longer play hide-and-seek. ⟦Consider an executive's urgent pending folder, where incoming petitions from each department are stamped with their respective project marks, large drafting boards slide aside upon arrival, and pending requisitions remain securely on the desk even after the leadership meeting adjourns.⟧ Review cards submitted by background subagents no longer vanish without reason when a parent turn ends. Pop-up authorization notifications now explicitly indicate which session requires your approval. In minimal mode, if a permission prompt coincides with a hidden plan or cancel panel, the screen reliably renders the permission prompt. Whenever a review card appears, the program also automatically closes the block viewer to prevent card content from being obscured.

items.original:
Approval cards for background subagents no longer disappear when the parent turn ends
Approval notifications name the session that needs approval
Minimal mode shows the permission prompt instead of a hidden plan or cancel panel when both are present
Approval cards close the block viewer so the card is visible

title.zh-TW: 工作樹刪除設下嚴格防線，使用中與外部目錄一律拒刪
title.en: Worktree Deletion Enforces Safeguards, Blocking Active and External Folders

body.zh-TW: 清理專案的多重副本時，重要程式碼與進行中的作業現在有更嚴密的保護。⟦恰如租車公司的還車清點機制，只要車輛仍有登記中的租約在路上行駛，就不允許註銷車籍；若開來的不是自家出租的車輛或整間調度場的總鑰匙，也會立刻拒絕受理。⟧使用工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，執行 `grok worktree rm` 或 `gc` 垃圾回收清理，若發現有開啟中的工作階段正使用該副本，指令會直接拒絕刪除。`grok worktree rm` 也設下了嚴格的安全防線，一律拒絕刪除任何 Git 儲存庫、`.git` 資料夾或任何非 grok 自行建立的目錄，不再因為手滑誤打指令而釀成災難。
body.en: When cleaning up multiple project copies, essential code and active work receive tighter safeguards. ⟦Rental car return inspections enforce a strict checklist: vehicles with active leases on the road cannot be deregistered, and returning an outside vehicle or a master lot key is turned away on the spot.⟧ When managing worktrees, running `grok worktree rm` or `gc` garbage collection cleanup will directly refuse deletion if an active session is currently using that copy. `grok worktree rm` also erects strict safety boundaries, flatly refusing to remove any Git repository, `.git` directory, or any folder not created by grok itself, preventing mistyped commands from causing disaster.

items.original:
`grok worktree rm` and `gc` no longer delete a worktree that an open session is using
`grok worktree rm` refuses to delete git repositories, `.git` folders, or any directory grok did not create

title.zh-TW: 脈絡溢位觸發自動精簡，對話過長不再當機或循環
title.en: Context Overflow Triggers Compaction, Ending Crashes and Loops in Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 進行長篇對話或調用大量工具時，記憶空間被塞爆的窘境現在有了自動排解機制。⟦彷彿隨行秘書在會議記錄爆量時主動整理精華提要，騰出筆記本空間讓會議繼續進行，若連續重抄三次重點依然爆頁，也會老實停筆確認，不再盲目撕頁重寫。⟧如果工具回合內容過長且包含工具使用後的自訂掛鉤輸出，程式會主動壓縮摘要，不再直接撞上提示詞長度上限。當遇上脈絡溢位（context overflow，對話總長度超出模型單次能處理的容量）錯誤時，程式會自動觸發壓縮，不再讓當前回合直接當掉。為了避免無休止的壓縮消耗資源，自動壓縮只要連續三次填滿脈絡就會主動停下，不再陷入死迴圈。
body.en: During lengthy conversations with AI or extensive tool usage, the frustration of exhausted memory space now has an automatic resolution mechanism. ⟦An executive secretary condenses key highlights as meeting minutes swell, freeing notebook space so discussions proceed, and pauses to verify after overflowing pages three times in a row rather than tearing out sheets blindly.⟧ If a tool turn runs overly long and includes custom post-tool hook output, the program proactively summarizes and compacts the content instead of colliding with prompt length limits. When a context overflow error occurs, the program automatically triggers compaction rather than letting the current turn crash. To prevent runaway compaction from consuming resources, automatic compaction pauses after filling the context three consecutive times, preventing infinite loops.

items.original:
Long tool turns that include PostToolUse hook output compact instead of hitting the prompt length limit
Context overflow errors trigger automatic compaction instead of failing the turn
Auto-compaction stops after three context refills in a row instead of looping

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動濾除 BOM，MCP 工具遇無效字元不再逾時
title.en: Headless Mode Filters BOMs, and MCP Tools Avoid Timeouts on Invalid Characters

body.zh-TW: 利用自動化腳本批次餵入提示詞或串接外部服務時，隱形字元造成的離奇錯誤現在已徹底排除。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下，如果提示詞檔案開頭帶有微軟檔案常見的 BOM 位元組順序記號，程式會主動濾除，不再把多餘標記送給模型，也不會弄壞 JSON 提示詞檔。當外部工具透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）回傳結果時，即便內容夾雜無效字元，也不會再導致工具呼叫逾時卡死。以前這些肉眼看不到的編碼符號常在暗處作怪，讓排程任務莫名中斷或卡在等待畫面，現在這類字元解析問題已經修好。⟦就像自動驗票機讀取票卡，以前表面只要沾了看不見的殘膠或夾帶污漬就會卡死閘門，現在能主動濾除干擾順利放行。⟧
body.en: When feeding prompt batches via automation scripts or connecting external services, bizarre errors caused by invisible characters are now eliminated. In headless mode, if a prompt file starts with a BOM byte-order mark common to Microsoft files, the program proactively strips it away, preventing extraneous markers from reaching the model or corrupting JSON prompt files. When external tools return results over MCP, invalid characters in the payload will no longer trigger tool call timeouts or freezes. Where invisible encoding symbols previously caused subtle bugs that abruptly halted scheduled tasks or left processes hanging, character parsing issues of this kind are now resolved. ⟦Automated ticket gates scan transit cards: where invisible adhesive residue or stray smudges once jammed the turnstile, the sensor now filters out surface noise to let passengers through smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Headless prompts that start with a byte-order mark no longer send that mark to the model, and no longer break JSON prompt files
MCP tool replies that contain invalid characters no longer cause the call to time out

title.zh-TW: 背景工作流程支援即時控管，修訂意見核准不遺漏

body.zh-TW:
當你指派耗時較長的自動化任務時，現在可以直接掌握背景作業的即時動態。

⟦像在工廠產線增設了專屬控制台，以前放行的作業只能等它自己跑完，現在每條輸送帶都能隨時按鈕暫停，中途貼上的便箋也會老實留到驗收。⟧

輸入 `/workflow` 即可列出、停止或恢復背景工作流程（依序執行的自動化任務清單），任務面板中也會同步出現這些項目與停止按鈕。執行 `/workflow stop` 或 `/workflow resume` 時，指令會精確對準目前運作中的工作流程。

在計畫修訂執行期間留下的評論，核准計畫時會完整保留並送出。若背景執行的命令發現工作目錄不存在，會立刻回報失敗，不會因為後續傳來殘留輸出而重新切換回執行狀態。
body.en:
When assigning long-running automated tasks, you can now directly track real-time activity for background operations.

⟦Picture a dedicated control console added to a factory floor: tasks once dispatched no longer just run unmonitored to completion, as every conveyor belt can be paused at the press of a button, and notes attached midway stay preserved until final inspection.⟧

Typing `/workflow` lists, stops, or resumes background workflows (ordered sequences of automated tasks), which also appear synchronously alongside stop buttons in the task panel. Running `/workflow stop` or `/workflow resume` accurately targets the currently active workflow.

Comments left during plan revision runs are fully preserved and submitted when approving the plan. If a background command discovers its working directory is missing, it immediately reports failure without flipping back to a running state due to lingering subsequent output.

Background shell commands fail immediately when the working directory does not exist, and no longer flip back to running when late output arrives

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式完整等待目標結果，背景任務暫停與重開更穩定

body.zh-TW:
想用腳本在背景批次跑完專案目標時，你不再需要盲目猜測任務究竟有沒有順利收尾。

⟦走進投幣式洗衣店洗衣服，以前按下開關後你不知道衣服洗好了沒，現在螢幕會確實等到脫水完成才跳出收據；按下暫停鍵會止水，中途打開機門重新關上也能繼續運轉。⟧

在 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）下執行 `grok -p` 時，程式會等待背景目標徹底完成並回報最終成果。若加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數，超過時限就會主動中止目標，結束時也不會再誤印多餘的暫停訊息。

針對執行中的目標按下 `Ctrl+C` 即可暫停，重新開啟對話時能直接延續目標進度。若設定中關閉了目標功能，無頭模式會把輸入的 `/goal` 指令當成一般文字提問處理。
body.en:
When running scripts to batch-process project goals in the background, you no longer have to guess whether tasks completed cleanly.

⟦Stepping into a laundromat, you no longer have to wonder if laundry finished after pressing start, because the screen now waits until spin-drying completes before issuing a receipt; pressing pause halts the water, and opening the door mid-cycle allows washing to resume once closed.⟧

When running `grok -p` in headless mode (execution without a terminal window), the process waits for background goals to fully finish and reports the final outcome. Supplying the `--background-wait-timeout` flag automatically terminates the goal when the deadline expires, without printing extraneous pause notices upon completion.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` pauses an active goal, allowing you to resume its progress directly when reopening the conversation. If goal features are disabled in settings, headless mode treats an entered `/goal` command as a standard text query.

title.zh-TW: 工作樹支援新版本庫格式，特殊檔案與目錄遺失不再卡死

當你在複雜專案下切換分支時，各項副本操作現在能避開路徑陷阱。

⟦就像植株分盆，以前泥土夾帶石塊或標籤偏移就會停工，現在換到新型花盆或找不到原土，幼苗依然能穩固扎根。⟧

`grok worktree`（工作樹，讓專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援 Jujutsu 版本庫。建立副本時就算內含具名管道或通訊端，也不再卡死。

`GROK_HOME` 設為符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）時，用 `-w` 建立的副本仍維持追蹤。若原啟動資料夾已刪，`grok -w` 會附提示退回根目錄。

`grok -p --output-format json` 會回報所用目錄，名稱衝突也清楚。`grok sessions list` 與 `/resume` 會顯示同子目錄啟動的工作階段，並隱藏相鄰子模組紀錄。
body.en:
When switching branches across complex projects, managing separate copies now avoids path pitfalls.

⟦Repotting a plant no longer stalls when soil carries stones or labels drift out of place, allowing seedlings to take firm root even when moved to a new style of pot or when original soil is missing.⟧

`grok worktree` (a feature enabling parallel copies of a project) supports Jujutsu repositories. Creating a copy no longer hangs even when named pipes or sockets are present.

When `GROK_HOME` is set to a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location), copies created with `-w` maintain active tracking. If the original launch folder was deleted, `grok -w` falls back to the root directory with a helpful notice.

Running `grok -p --output-format json` reports the directory used, clarifying name collisions. Both `grok sessions list` and `/resume` display sessions started from the same subdirectory while hiding adjacent submodule records.

執行 `grok worktree rm` 或 `gc`（資源回收，清理廢棄副本資料的維護指令）時，即使手動刪除資料夾或重建資料庫，也能正確清理與還原登記名稱。若未追蹤內容只剩空資料夾則直接放行刪除；沒帶 `-f` 參數時，未儲存修改檢查失敗或逾時會保留副本以防遺失。

When cleaning up retired parallel development copies, safeguards and scanning efficiency both see tangible improvements.

⟦Like a warehouse clerk auditing vacated lockers, automated deregistration prevents losing track of inventory after manual removals or unstable connections, while residual empty boxes are cleared out cleanly and inventory checks run much faster.⟧

Running `grok worktree rm` or `gc` (a maintenance command that cleans up discarded copies) cleans up properly and restores registered names even after manually deleting folders or rebuilding the database. Untracked content that consists only of empty folders is permitted for deletion. Without the `-f` flag, the copy is preserved if checks for unsaved changes fail or time out.

Running `grok worktree list` now displays unfinished copies left behind by interruptions. All `grok worktree` commands skip loading model directories at startup. Opening the `/resume` picker is also noticeably smoother when managing large numbers of copies.

現在只有位在訊息最開頭的斜線指令才會觸發 skill（擴充技能，賦予模型特定操作能力的功能模組）。如果手動輸入 `/cd` 等未公開的隱藏指令，系統會確實執行該指令，不會被名稱相近的擴充技能攔截。

Multi-select questions let you toggle several answers with number keys before submitting
Dialogs such as `/feedback` stay readable on a short terminal, and failed send status wraps inside the dialog

title.zh-TW: 儀表板工作階段釘選持久保留，路徑支援引號與刪除防呆
title.en: Dashboard session pins persist across restarts, supporting quoted paths and safe deletions

body.zh-TW:
當你在多個專案工作階段之間頻繁檢視切換時，面板清單的排列與操作防呆更加穩當。

⟦恰似辦公室牆上的磁吸公告板，以前下班關燈後標籤順序容易被打亂、撤下的舊單子還黏在角落，現在釘選的常用便箋重開機後依然整齊歸位，撕下作廢單據也不會留下殘膠。⟧

在 dashboard（儀表板，統一管理所有對話任務的總覽面板）中釘選的工作階段，現在會嚴格維持當初釘選的順序，即使重開程式也不會跑掉。關閉工作階段後，該項目會確實清除，不再殘留在未啟用清單中。

在詳細資訊檢視中輸入 `/exit`，只會單獨關閉當前檢視的工作階段。使用 Peek 快速預覽時，透過上下鍵移動焦點後再按數字鍵，不會再錯誤指派到非預期的代理程式。

執行 `/cd` 或使用位置選擇器時，現在允許路徑包含引號或跳脫字元。輸入 `/delete` 指令時若後方接有多餘字串，會直接回報錯誤，不再誤將目前的工作階段直接刪除。
body.en:
When frequently inspecting and switching between multiple project sessions, panel ordering and operational safeguards are far more dependable.

⟦Imagine a magnetic bulletin board on an office wall: pinned routine notices return neatly to their original spots after rebooting instead of scrambling when lights go out, and discarded slips leave no sticky residue behind when torn away.⟧

Pinned sessions in the dashboard (an overview panel managing all conversation tasks) now strictly preserve their original pinning order even after restarting. Closing a session clears the item completely instead of leaving it stranded in the inactive list.

Entering `/exit` from the detail view closes only the currently viewed session. During Peek previews, moving focus with arrow keys before pressing number keys no longer assigns tasks to unintended agents.

Executing `/cd` or using the location picker now permits paths containing quotes or escaped characters. Entering `/delete` with trailing characters returns an immediate error instead of accidentally deleting the active session.

items.original:
Pinned dashboard sessions stay in the order you pinned them, and survive restarts
`/exit` in a dashboard details view closes only that session
`/cd` and the location picker accept quoted or escaped folder paths
`/delete` with extra text shows an error instead of deleting the current session
Number-key picks in the dashboard peek no longer go to the wrong agent after Up/Down
Closing a session in the dashboard no longer leaves it listed under Inactive

title.zh-TW: 編輯重送不再還原工作區，登入指引明確且登出即停輪次
title.en: Resending edited messages preserves workspace files, clarifying login steps and halting turns on logout

body.zh-TW:
在長時間對話中反覆修改需求時，程式碼檔案與帳號狀態能獲得更周全的保護。

⟦正像在建築事務所修改設計圖，以前重寫上一道草稿，桌面上做好的模型就會被推倒重來，現在重新遞交只更新圖紙，砌好的磚牆完好無損。⟧

在長工作階段中取消並重新編輯送出訊息時，不再會錯誤還原工作區的檔案。登出時會立即中斷本機工作階段正在執行的輪次。

登入失敗時會提供清楚的下一步指引，不再直接丟出原始錯誤。若 `grok -p` 尚未儲存登入憑證，會自動執行設定的認證命令（`auth_provider_command`）。

開啟工作階段時若未能取得模型清單，會自動切換為 Auto 模型。對空白工作階段執行 `/compact`（壓縮對話紀錄以騰出容量的指令）時，也不再重設回報的上下文視窗數值。
body.en:
When repeatedly refining requirements throughout long conversations, code files and account states receive more comprehensive protection.

⟦Revising blueprints at an architectural firm no longer knocks over finished models on the desk when rewriting an earlier draft, because resubmissions update only the drawings while freshly laid brick walls remain intact.⟧

Canceling and re-editing submitted messages during long sessions no longer mistakenly reverts files in the workspace. Logging out immediately halts active turns in local sessions.

Login failures provide clear next steps instead of dumping raw errors. If `grok -p` has no saved login credentials, it automatically executes the configured authentication command (`auth_provider_command`).

Opening a session falls back to the Auto model when failing to retrieve the model list. Running `/compact` (a command condensing conversation history to free space) on an empty session also no longer resets reported context window values.

items.original:
Cancel and edit-resend on long sessions no longer revert workspace files
`grok -p` runs `auth_provider_command` when no login is stored
Sessions that open without a model list use Auto
Sign-in failures show a clear next step instead of a raw error
Logging out stops running turns on local sessions
`/compact` on an empty session no longer resets the reported context window

title.zh-TW: 工具權限參數對齊模型名稱，記憶簡化為開關並新增密度控制
title.en: Tool Permission Flags Align with Model Names, Memory Simplifies to a Toggle, and Density Controls Are Added

body.zh-TW:
透過命令列微調模型時，設定項目與工具授權更加直觀。

⟦正如調音台旋鈕對齊螢幕名稱，開關回歸單純啟閉。⟧

`--disallowed-tools` 可直接填入模型看到的名稱（如 `run_terminal_command` 或 `spawn_subagent`）。無頭模式新增 `--allowed-tools` 作為 `--allow` 別名。

`/density` 與 Tool call density 設定可控制工具呼叫的細節多寡。`--system-prompt` 會自動附加 `--append-system-prompt` 的規則。

記憶簡化為單純開關，設定檔僅需 `[memory]` 的 `enabled` 鍵。命令列已移除 `/share` 指令與工作階段分享功能。
body.en:
When fine-tuning models from the command line, configuration options and tool permissions become more intuitive.

⟦A mixing console aligns its knobs with screen labels, while switches return to simple on-off toggles.⟧

`--disallowed-tools` accepts the exact names seen by the model (such as `run_terminal_command` or `spawn_subagent`). Headless mode adds `--allowed-tools` as an alias for `--allow`.

`/density` and the Tool call density setting control the level of detail in tool calls. `--system-prompt` automatically appends rules from `--append-system-prompt`.

Memory is simplified into a straightforward toggle, requiring only the `enabled` key under `[memory]` in configuration files. The command line removes the `/share` command and session sharing features.

items.original:
Memory is only an on or off switch (`[memory] enabled`)
The `/share` command and session sharing are removed from the CLI
`/density` and the Tool call density setting control how much detail tool calls show
`--allowed-tools` is accepted as an alias for `--allow` in headless mode
`--disallowed-tools` accepts the names shown to the model, such as `run_terminal_command` and `spawn_subagent`
`--system-prompt` appends rules from `--append-system-prompt`
